step1_figure.circuit_type: Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) Sensing Circuit for CMOS Image Sensor
step1_figure.description: An NMOS-input delta-sigma modulator sensing circuit using MOSFETs as switched-capacitor charge-metering cups and integrating bucket capacitors, connected to a clocked dynamic comparator with a NOR-based SR latch for feedback modulation.

shifted_reference_voltage.description: Effective reference voltage shifted by NMOS threshold voltage drop

equation.explanation: The reference input transistor operates as a source follower, shifting the input level down by V_THN.
equation.assumptions: NMOS source follower operated in strong inversion/saturation, body tied to ground.

sky130_expected.calculation: With V_R = 0.65 V and SKY130 NFET threshold voltage V_THN = 0.42 V: V_R,shift = 0.65 - 0.42 = 0.23 V (230 mV).
sky130_expected.reasoning: V_THN varies across process corners between 0.35 V and 0.50 V for the 1.8V standard NFET.

shifted_intensity_voltage.description: Effective signal intensity voltage shifted by NMOS threshold voltage drop

equation.explanation: The signal column input transistor shifts the illumination level down by V_THN.
equation.assumptions: V_I > V_THN so the device remains turned on.

sky130_expected.calculation: For an illumination level of V_I = 0.55 V and V_THN = 0.42 V: V_I,shift = 0.55 - 0.42 = 0.13 V (130 mV).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by light level input ranging from 450 mV up to Vr = 650 mV.

converter_resolution.description: Voltage resolution per clock cycle for N oversampling cycles

equation.explanation: Quantization step size across the full-scale range defined by the shifted reference voltage over N cycles.
equation.assumptions: Linear charge balancing over N measurement clock cycles.

sky130_expected.calculation: For N = 100 clock cycles and V_R,shift = 230 mV: V_res = 230 mV / 100 = 2.3 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Proportional to V_R,shift divided by oversampling ratio N.

thermal_noise_hold_cap.description: RMS thermal noise sampled onto the column sample-and-hold capacitor

equation.explanation: kT/C sampling noise on the hold capacitor CH during pixel reset and readout.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_n,rms = sqrt(1.38e-23 * 300 / 1e-12) = sqrt(4.14e-9) = 64.3 uV. Peak-to-peak is ~6 * 64.3 uV = 386 uV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fundamental thermal limit set purely by capacitor value and temperature.

switched_capacitor_equivalent_resistance.description: Effective equivalent resistance of the switched-capacitor reference branch

equation.explanation: Equivalent average resistance created by switching the cup capacitance at frequency f_clk.
equation.assumptions: Capacitor fully charges and discharges each cycle.

sky130_expected.calculation: With f_clk = 100 MHz (T = 10 ns), C_cup ~ 100 fF: R_eq = 1 / (100e6 * 100e-15) = 100 kOhm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on clock switching rate and PMOS inversion capacitance.

average_sensing_power.description: Total DC and dynamic power consumption during DSM sensing operation

equation.explanation: Total active power from VDD supply including current mirrors, switched caps, and dynamic latch.
equation.assumptions: VDD = 1.8 V, continuous clocking at 100 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Branch currents in mirrors ~ 10 uA - 20 uA, dynamic switching current ~ 20 uA: I_avg ~ 40 uA. P_avg = 1.8 V * 40 uA = 72 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Low power image sensor column architecture running at 100 MHz.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench simulating 1500 ns of DSM operation with non-overlapping clocks phi1/phi2, evaluating comparator latching, bucket capacitor charge balance, pulse density output Qi, and average power.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Sky130 Testbench for Baker Fig 17.36 Delta-Sigma Sensing Circuit
.lib "/home/designer/sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Parameter definitions for DUT sizing
.param W_xm1=1.0u  L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=1.0u  L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=5.0u  L_xm3=1.5u
.param W_xm4=1.0u  L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm5=1.0u  L_xm5=0.15u
.param W_xm6=1.0u  L_xm6=0.15u
.param W_xm7=1.0u  L_xm7=1.5u
.param W_xm8=1.0u  L_xm8=0.15u
.param W_xm9=1.0u  L_xm9=0.15u
.param W_xm10=1.0u L_xm10=0.15u
.param W_xm11=5.0u L_xm11=1.5u
.param W_xm12=1.0u L_xm12=1.5u
.param W_xm13=50.0u L_xm13=1.5u
.param W_xm14=50.0u L_xm14=1.5u
.param W_xm15=2.0u L_xm15=0.15u
.param W_xm16=2.0u L_xm16=0.15u
.param W_xm17=2.0u L_xm17=0.15u
.param W_xm18=2.0u L_xm18=0.15u
.param W_xm19=2.0u L_xm19=0.15u
.param W_xm20=2.0u L_xm20=0.15u
.param W_xm21=1.0u L_xm21=0.15u
.param W_xm22=1.0u L_xm22=0.15u
.param W_xm23=1.0u L_xm23=0.15u
.param W_xm24=1.0u L_xm24=0.15u

* Power Supplies
VDD VDD 0 1.8
Vr Vr 0 650m
Vi Vi 0 400m

* Non-overlapping two-phase clock generator (100 MHz, T=10ns)
Vphi1 phi1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.5n 0.1n 0.1n 3.8n 10n)
Vphi2 phi2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 5.5n 0.1n 0.1n 3.8n 10n)

* DUT Instance
xm3 VDD N005 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm5 N006 phi2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm7 vbuck vbucki VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm1 N005 phi2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 N004 phi1 N006 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm4 N003 phi1 N005 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm6 N002 VDD N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm8 N001 Q N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
xm9 vbuck Vi N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
xm10 vbucki Vr N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
xm11 VDD N006 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
xm12 vbucki vbucki VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
xm13 0 vbuck 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm13} l={L_xm13}
xm14 0 vbucki 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm14} l={L_xm14}
xm15 n1 vbuck VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm15} l={L_xm15}
xm16 n2 vbucki VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm16} l={L_xm16}
xm17 n3 Out n1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm17} l={L_xm17}
xm18 n4 Outi n2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm18} l={L_xm18}
xm19 Outi phi2 n3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm19} l={L_xm19}
xm20 Out phi2 n4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm20} l={L_xm20}
xm21 Out Outi 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm21} l={L_xm21}
xm22 Outi Out 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm22} l={L_xm22}
xm23 Outi phi2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm23} l={L_xm23}
xm24 Out phi2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm24} l={L_xm24}
X_U1 Out Qi Q VDD 0 NOR_2
X_U2 Q Outi Qi VDD 0 NOR_2

.subckt NOR_2 A B Out VDD GND
  xm3 out B N001 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1.0u l=0.15u
  xm8 N001 A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1.0u l=0.15u
  xm11 out B GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5u l=0.15u
  xm12 out A 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5u l=0.15u
.ends NOR_2

.control
* Run transient analysis mimicking Baker's setup
tran 0.1n 1500n uic

* Measure average voltages on bucket capacitors across steady-state sensing window (500n to 1500n)
meas tran vbuck_avg avg v(vbuck) from=500n to=1500n
meas tran vbucki_avg avg v(vbucki) from=500n to=1500n
meas tran vdiff_bucket param='vbuck_avg - vbucki_avg'

* Measure average power consumption from VDD
meas tran i_vdd_avg avg i(VDD) from=500n to=1500n
let p_avg = -i_vdd_avg * 1.8
print p_avg

* Measure high-level duty ratio / average pulse density of DSM output Qi
meas tran qi_avg avg v(Qi) from=500n to=1500n
let ones_ratio = qi_avg / 1.8
print ones_ratio

quit
.endc
.end
